title: gm-delegate proposal record
description: NORMATIVE. Spec §5.7. A proposal MUST be a complete placement instruction. place_encounter(proposalId) takes no other arguments, so anything absent here cannot be recovered without re-rolling, and a re-roll would place creatures the GM never accepted. That is the single rule this file exists to enforce.

expires_ts.description: created_ts + TTL. On expiry, emit gm_action 'expired' to the log BEFORE discarding. A sweeper that silently deletes throws away the cheapest training signal in the system (§5.7).

opened.description: Distinguishes 'skip' (opened, then refused) from 'expired' (never seen). Two different labels; do not collapse them.

scene_id.description: Scene active at proposal time. If the GM has since changed scenes, placement targets the CURRENT scene; log the mismatch.

creatures.description: Complete placement instruction. packId + actorId let place_encounter import without re-fetching; quantity is what Foundry already rolled.

sourceUuid.description: Compendium UUID. Stamped onto the imported world Actor as flags['gm-delegate'].sourceUuid and used to dedupe on the next encounter (§5.2).

edited.description: Set when the GM used Edit. The edited text is what gets placed and what gets logged as card_text; the original survives in gm_edit_diff.
